answer.rationale: memory_57 is strongest because it directly reports qualified revenue and no measurable retention harm, though only among established customers. memory_44 links the intervention to pipeline quality but omits realized revenue and long-term outcomes. memory_73 reports acquisition and revenue lift, but omits margins, retention, and post-promotion durability. memory_31 shows a durable activation lift, while memory_86 shows improved onboarding and adoption; both are upstream indicators without demonstrated qualified-revenue impact. memory_91 is weakest because it reports only short-term engagement and first actions, with no evidence of durability, qualification, retention, or revenue.
